title: Miracle Thieves
hook: Four broke wizards rob a cathedral that hoards miracles, crack its vault and run home before the grates shut.
description: Four broke wizards rob a cathedral that hoards miracles, alone or with up to three friends who can drop in mid-heist. You only move and dash: your spells fire by themselves, every pick changes how your magic behaves, and frost, fire, sparks, ink and bells set each other off. Wheel the displaced relics home, hold the Reliquary, break the wax seals, face the Custodian of Lesser Miracles, then run for the Service Yard before the grates shut.
goal: Crack the Vault of Lesser Miracles and get a thief home to the Service Yard.
tips: Bring every displaced relic home to the wheelbarrow and the galleries open early; the clock is only a fallback.
The Custodian's bells ring before every attack, so listen, and dash when they toll.
A fallen friend turns into a ghost: stand beside them for a couple of seconds to bring them back.
contentNote: Cartoon magic, crowds of foes and bright flashes. Settings offer Reduced flashing, which stops full-screen flashes and calms the rest, and a camera-shake slider that goes down to off.

keyboard.note: Spells cast themselves; ZQSD works too
On the title, as your wizard

touch.note: A thumb-stick opens where you touch
